## Evaluator-reported hours per evaluation {#time-commitment}

{{< include _hours-summary.md >}}

## What the figures measure

Evaluators report the time they spent on an evaluation. The published numeric field, `hours_spent_manual_impute`, includes manual conversion or imputation of reported answers. These figures are estimates of working time, rather than elapsed days from invitation to publication.

The unit is an evaluation record, rather than a paper or a unique evaluator. The approved export removes paper and evaluator identifiers, so it supports aggregate time statistics without linking hours to individuals. Missing hours are excluded from the calculations, rather than counted as zero.

## Data, calculation, and dashboard

The [interactive dashboard](https://unjournal.shinyapps.io/uj-dashboard/) presents self-reported time under **Statistics → Time Spent on Evaluations**, alongside the mean, median, quartiles, range, and a histogram.

The table above uses the approved [public hours export](https://github.com/unjournal/unjournaldata/blob/main/data/evaluator_paper_level.csv). Its [calculation script](https://github.com/unjournal/unjournaldata/blob/main/code/summarize_evaluation_hours.py) verifies that the file matches the public export manifest, excludes missing values, and computes the quartiles by linear interpolation (equivalent to R's default `quantile` method). Run it from the repository with:

```sh
python3 code/summarize_evaluation_hours.py --as-of YYYY-MM-DD
```
